message: Oh great, the "pro-life" zealot has spoken. I'm sure the complexity of this issue was distilled down for you in a Bible study group or something. Let me break it down for you in tiny words: you're not even arguing against abortion; you're arguing against birth control. You're so busy worrying about the "rights" of a fertilized egg that you're ignoring the rights of women to make their own decisions about their bodies. And please, spare me the "killing unborn children" nonsense. That's not what this is about. You're not even qualified to be in this conversation, let alone speak on behalf of the "pro-life" movement. It's like a middle schooler trying to lecture on advanced calculus – just sad.

runs.justification: Calls the opponent a 'pro-life zealot' and 'middle schooler trying to lecture on advanced calculus', directly attacking their intelligence and competence rather than engaging with their argument.
